# Requirements Quality Checklist: Chat Quality & Model Management

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of the feature-003 spec/plan/tasks — "unit tests for English" across all four stories (sampling, KV reuse, rich chat, model library/downloads).
**Created**: 2025-11-11
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all configurable generation parameters enumerated with types, valid ranges, and defaults? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001/FR-002]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the deferral of reserved fields (`nThreads`, `nGpuLayers`, context size) explicitly documented as out-of-scope rather than silently unwired? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK003 Are `Message.stats` fields (token count, tokens/second) defined with units and specified behavior when a turn is partial or failed? [Completeness, Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK004 Are `ModelMeta` field nullability rules specified for GGUFs that omit metadata keys (e.g., `parameter_count`)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK005 Is the parameter resolution order (built-in defaults ← global settings ← per-model override) documented in one place? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK006 Is the download filename derivation specified when the user omits `fileName` (URL tail vs required field)? [Clarity, Gap, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the models directory location/derivation specified (repo `models/` in dev vs user-data dir when packaged)? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Are model-file management actions (rename/delete from the library) specified or explicitly excluded? [Gap, Spec §FR-010]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK009 Is "end cleanly at the token cap" defined — does the turn land as `complete` or `partial`, and is that stated? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK010 Is `temperature: 0` mapped to deterministic/greedy decoding in the requirements? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001]
- [ ] CHK011 Is "copies the raw message text" defined — markdown source vs rendered plaintext? [Clarity, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the sidebar filter's matching rule defined (case sensitivity, substring vs prefix)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK013 Is "identical outputs" under a fixed seed defined bit-exactly (same bytes) vs semantically? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK014 Do the KV-reuse descriptions in spec (FR-005), research (D2/D8), data-model (token mirror), and tasks (T016) all describe the same mechanism? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK015 Does `chat.edit` "delete later turns" remain consistent with the persistence/state-transition rules in FR-013? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007/FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Are the download URL allowlist rules identical between the spec (FR-011) and the RPC contract's `INVALID_URL` semantics? [Consistency]
- [ ] CHK017 Are `model.setOverride` validation semantics consistent with the `INVALID_PARAMS` error code contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK018 Does the local-first/offline principle coexist cleanly with the network download feature (is the boundary documented)? [Consistency, Assumption, Constitution §I]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK019 Is the restated SC-002 (warm flag + suffix-only decode) objectively verifiable from observable signals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK020 Is SC-004's "≥200 MB" a realistic, available test asset and is the measurement point defined? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK021 Does SC-005 enumerate which new test areas prove the gates (params plumbing, KV reuse, regeneration, metadata)? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-005]
- [ ] CHK022 Is each user story's independent test in quickstart.md traceable to specific FRs? [Traceability, Spec §VS-1…VS-5]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK023 Is the behavior specified when regenerate is invoked while a generation is in flight (`ENGINE_BUSY`) or when no assistant turn exists (`NOT_FOUND`)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK024 Is `chat.edit` behavior specified when invoked mid-generation or on an assistant message? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK025 Are download failure modes covered — HTTP error, mid-transfer abort, disk full, `.part` cleanup — in requirements? [Exception Flow, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK026 Is behavior specified for corrupt/non-GGUF files inside the models directory? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK027 Are message-action availability rules defined per message state (generating/partial/failed/complete)? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK028 Is behavior defined when a single user message alone exceeds the context budget (nothing droppable)? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the interaction between KV reuse and regenerate/edit specified (divergence handling after history rewrites)? [Coverage, Spec §FR-005/FR-007]
- [ ] CHK030 Is concurrent behavior specified for a download running while the active model is unloaded/switched? [Coverage, Gap, Spec §FR-011/FR-013]

## Non-Functional & Dependencies

- [ ] CHK031 Is the no-full-buffering requirement for downloads stated (stream-to-disk memory discipline)? [NFR, Spec §FR-011, Constitution]
- [ ] CHK032 Is single-flight generation behavior under rapid consecutive UI actions (send → edit → regenerate) specified? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the no-auth `resolve/` URL limitation documented as an assumption with its consequence (private/gated repos unsupported)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK034 Is the stats display-only scope documented (no latency SLO implied by tokens/sec)? [Assumption, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK035 Are FFI ownership/validity rules for the new `lls_gguf_meta` string result documented consistently with existing `lls_free_string` discipline? [Consistency, Contract §ffi]

## Notes

- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist state but does not modify markers.
- Items marked `[Gap]` check for requirements that may be intentionally absent — confirm scope before treating as defects.
